title: Le poids de la sentinelle
coordinateSystem: LevelSpec source coordinates before centering; x increases right, y increases down.
method: Exhaustive support-placement enumeration on a permissive terrain-and-reflection graph; no actor-state BFS.

model.mirror: One NE mirror, freely repositionable within its supported terrain component.
model.heroMoves: Independent cardinal walking plus both directions of every unobstructed NE reflection from every allowed mirror position.
ignoredConstraints: Which hero can move the mirror
The work needed to create the chosen support
retainedConstraints: Walls and the permanently closed green gate block movement and rays
Heroes need supported departure and arrival cells
The single mirror cannot teleport itself or change its orientation
model.justification: The only crate can create at most one permanent support. Granting any water cell as a support from the beginning, free mirror relocation and occupant-free rays includes every legal trajectory while adding many impossible ones. If neither target is reachable in any such graph, no legal solution can keep the green gate closed throughout.

positiveControls.note: These permissive graph paths check the proof model; they are not claimed to be playable game solutions.

scope: Proves that the green gate must open at least once for this exact map. It does not prove a unique solution or the necessity of every object or of the recorded witness.
